selection_note: Rebuilt from deployed PCA coverage pool plus random augmentation for underrepresented families. Final bank has exactly 1000 samples per morphology family and uses 24x24 PCA-grid round-robin within each family, so random click selection no longer collapses to one region/family.
wave_objective_note: This is still a browser PCA proxy bank. Code sets physics_calibrated=0 to reproduce PCA coordinates; native wave sweep is required before treating a pattern as wave-valid.
training_weight_note: training_weight is recomputed after rebalancing; family mass remains balanced.
